title: Appeals and Grievances — Required Documents and Review Time Limits by Tier
content:
## Case documents and review clock

For each Appeals and Grievances tier the schedule fixes the documents that must be on file before a decision, the time the appellant has to answer a records request, the acknowledgment and decision time limits, the reviewer who may decide and where the appellant follows the case.

- *Required documents*: the kinds of document that must be on file before a decision.
- *Records window*: calendar days the appellant has to send records once the reviewer asks for them.
- *Acknowledgment*: business days after receipt within which the case is acknowledged.
- *Decision time limit*: the time limit for the decision, counted in the stated unit from receipt.
- *Independent reviewer*: whether the reviewer must not have taken part in the initial determination.
- *Physician reviewer*: whether a physician of the same or similar specialty must decide.
- *Status inquiry*: where the appellant can follow the case.

| Tier | Required documents | Records window (calendar days) | Acknowledgment (business days) | Decision time limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | Explanation of Benefits | 30 | 5 | 30 calendar days |
| Beneficiary Grievance | none | 0 | 5 | 30 calendar days |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | Explanation of Benefits | 30 | 5 | 30 calendar days |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | statement of good cause | 30 | 5 | 30 calendar days |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | denial letter; medical records | 30 | 5 | 30 calendar days |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | denial letter; treating provider expedited certification | 1 | 1 | 3 business days |

| Tier | Independent reviewer | Physician reviewer | Status inquiry |
|---|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | yes | no | beneficiary web portal and customer service |
| Beneficiary Grievance | no | no | beneficiary web portal and customer service |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | yes | no | beneficiary web portal and customer service |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | yes | no | beneficiary web portal and customer service |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes | yes | beneficiary web portal and customer service |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | yes | yes | beneficiary web portal and customer service |

### Reading the clock

| Tier | Decision time limit in figures | Unit |
|---|---|---|
| Allowable Charge Review | 30 | calendar days |
| Beneficiary Grievance | 30 | calendar days |
| Claim Factual Reconsideration | 30 | calendar days |
| Enrollment Reinstatement Review | 30 | calendar days |
| Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 30 | calendar days |
| Expedited Medical Necessity Reconsideration | 3 | business days |

A records window of 0 on the Beneficiary Grievance reflects that the grievance tier lists no required documents. Only the two medical necessity tiers call for a physician reviewer.
